title: Reliability, Boundaries & Capstone
description: Study treat retrieved instructions as untrusted, manage context and output budgets, portability and model changes, and capstone: a tested document assistant prompt. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Manage context and output budgets
lessons.description: Design an input selection and incomplete-output policy.
lessons.conceptOverview: Budget input evidence and expected output together. Remove irrelevant material, preserve mandatory constraints and detect truncation or incomplete results rather than presenting them as finished.
lessons.whyItMatters: Budget management should preserve essential evidence and completion checks.

lessons.title: Portability and model changes
lessons.description: Run the fixed evaluation suite and compare failure categories.
lessons.conceptOverview: Prompt behavior can vary across models, versions and settings. Maintain task-level evaluation and avoid assuming a wording trick transfers unchanged; revalidate contracts when the execution environment changes.
lessons.whyItMatters: Prompt portability should be measured with the task's contracts.

lessons.title: Capstone: a tested document assistant prompt
lessons.description: Deliver the prompt, examples, validation rubric and a versioned results table.
